english.title: Fail to leave security restricted area of air navigation installation after request from responsible authority / person
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, remained on part of a security restricted area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SECURITY RESTRICTED AREA..), of an air navigation installation, namely **(..SPECIFY the INSTALLATION..), not forming part of an aerodrome after being requested to leave by the responsible authority or person acting on behalf of the responsible authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21C(1)(b) and (3) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.

english.notes: This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document replaces CJS Code AV82057 and H2734 with effect from 29/04/2012 "restricted zone" amended to "security restricted area".
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, the defendant remained on part of a security restricted area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SECURITY RESTRICTED AREA..), of an air navigation installation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTALLATION..), not forming part of an aerodrome after being requested to leave by the responsible authority or person acting on behalf of the responsible authority.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
